An exam-bank question is answered only on an exam (400 exam_only without one) and never enters Review.

get.summary: Exam setup: the course's weeks and her exams
get.description: Every week with a current question: how many questions an exam over it draws from (its exam bank when it has one, otherwise its practice questions), how many of those she last answered not fully right, and which source it uses. Then her running exam in this course and her ended exams, newest first. An exam whose time has run out is ended first. The admin reads the same, read-only.

post.summary: Start an exam over the weeks she ticked
post.description: Draws up to 40 questions only from the ticked weeks, in proportion to each week's size, with 60 minutes for 40 or 1.5 minutes per question when the weeks hold fewer. A week with an exam bank gives its exam-bank questions; a week without one gives its practice questions, and once the course has any exam bank the exam lists such weeks in practiceWeeks. With pool `wrong`, only the questions she last answered not fully right are drawn: practice questions, exam-bank questions, and the exam twins of practice questions she got wrong (the one practice question of the same week whose id the exam question names in twinOf) until she answers the twin fully right; a ticked week with none is refused with `no_wrong_questions`. A running exam of hers ends first. Answers go to POST /api/attempts with this exam's id as studySessionId. The admin cannot start one.

get.description: Its questions in the order served and the ones she has answered. Once it has ended, the result: points, fully right, partly right, missed, guessed, not answered, minutes used, the by-week and by-clinical-judgment-step breakdowns, each question's mark, how many practice questions went to Review, and how many exam-bank questions she got wrong (they stay out of Review). An exam whose time has run out is ended first.

post.summary: End her exam and score it
post.description: `finished` when she finishes, `left` when she leaves midway, `timeout` when her time runs out. What she answered is scored; skipped and unreached questions score 0 and stay out of Review. After the time limit the end is recorded as a timeout. Ending an ended exam returns it unchanged. The admin cannot call this.

200.description: The ended exam with its result.
